_comment: Machine-readable trade intents. tools/execute_strategy.py validates every entry and
only sends anything when KALSHI_TRADING_ENABLED=1, a demo API key is configured, and
the run limits below are respected. With no orders listed nothing is ever sent.
side is from the buyer's point of view: yes or no. price is the YES price; a NO bet is
sent as book_side ask (sell YES) at 1 - price, per the documented book_side semantics.
